svg.title: The world's data-centre capacity by country income group
svg.desc: A dot map of the world, each country shaded by its income group. Low-income countries, in red, hold under 0.1% of global data-centre capacity; high-income countries, in dark ink, hold 77% (World Bank).
svg.text: Share of global data-centre capacity: World Bank, via economyofwisdom.org (Aug 2026) · income groups: Natural Earth
